create.name: Center for Spiritual Awareness
create.bio:
The Center for Spiritual Awareness is a Kriya Yoga ministry and retreat centre in the low mountains of Rabun County, north-east Georgia, about ninety miles north of Atlanta. It was set up by Roy Eugene Davis, one of the last personal disciples of Paramahansa Yogananda to teach in the West, and was incorporated as a non-profit in 1964. Since Davis's death in 2019 the work has been carried on by its spiritual director Marty Wuttke and a body of ministers he trained, in the line that runs from Babaji through Lahiri Mahasaya, Sri Yukteswar and Yogananda. Its outlook is non-sectarian: it holds that each person's essential nature is one with the Infinite, and it welcomes people of every faith.

The wooded grounds near Lake Rabun hold a meditation temple, a meeting hall where vegetarian meals are served, a hatha yoga dome, guest houses, two library buildings and a bookstore. From spring to the Christmas season it holds weekend and longer meditation retreats, many with a three-hour group meditation streamed on Zoom, and all of them offered by donation. Online there is a self-paced introductory course, a library of recorded talks and guided meditations, a monthly podcast and the Truth Journal.

courses.title: Holy Season 3-hour Meditation and Weekend Retreat
courses.description: A weekend on the Lakemont grounds built around a three-hour group meditation led in turn by the spiritual director and two ministers, also streamed on Zoom. Stay for the weekend or join the long sitting online; offered by donation.

free_resources.title: Wake Up with Roy Eugene Davis
free_resources.description: A free, self-paced online course in five parts, made of short talks and guided meditations by the centre's founder. No registration is needed; donations are welcome.

free_resources.title: Guided Meditations
free_resources.description: Recorded audio and video meditations from the centre's library, including breath and mantra practice and chakra meditations led by Roy Eugene Davis, and an inner smile meditation with Marty Wuttke.

free_resources.title: Kriya Yoga Teachers & Lineage
free_resources.description: Short and long recorded talks on the Kriya Yoga line of teachers, including Roy Eugene Davis's memories of Paramahansa Yogananda.

free_resources.title: Podcast
free_resources.description: The centre's monthly Kriya Yoga podcast with talks from its ministers.
